trigger: Post-merge CI of e9af38f: article click stayed on /en/insights; retry passed and failOnFlakyTests rejected the run.

trace.articleRequests: Two successful RSC prefetches only; no navigation request.

cause: focusin canceled the entrance transform between mouse press and release, moving the link away from the release point.
reproduction: Hold the real card entrance using WAAPI at its initial position; a normal Playwright pointer click fails to navigate before the fix.
fix: Only snap for focus-visible targets, preserving immediate keyboard reveal and the pointer geometry of article links.
scope: The regression covers links. focus-visible is a browser heuristic and can also match text inputs after pointer focus; no universal input-pointer behavior is claimed.

verification.focused: 20 passed, 10 repetitions of pointer and keyboard cases, no retries
verification.fullSuite: 53 passed, six Playwright projects, no retries, 1.5 minutes
